about: Recorded by tests/conformance/record.py: 'mac' from ArdiaPluginHost (JavaScriptCore + Foundation, macOS 27.2, swiftc -O, hardened runtime without the JIT entitlement), 'whatwg' from Node 24.22.2's URL and base64 (tests/conformance/node.mjs).
